text:
ana: Pushed a short migration playbook PR that bundles SDK snippet conversions, banner copy, and a tiny reindex appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999

vik: I can convert the Ruby + TS snippets. Will add iterator-based streaming examples and a tiny helper to assemble JSON frames.

joel: I'll handle Python snippets and the reindex pseudo CLI. Planning to include an estimate line for 100k vectors.

liz: Please also include a short "how to rollback" curl snippet and a recommended canary plan for model swaps. Marketing asked for simple banner copy too.

ana: Draft banner: "We plan to retire the v1 API on 2026-09-01. Migrate to v2 by 2026-08-01 to avoid interruption." Keep it linked to the guide.

vik: Noted. For streaming, I'll show legacy onEvent vs async iterator side-by-side.

joel: Reindex CLI: `reindex --src old-emb --dst new-emb --batch 500`. Adding a note: reindex cost approx $11 per 100k (estimate).

liz: Add `owner:` labels in the PR files and a docs-smoke GH Action that runs top examples against a local shim.

docs-bot: Reminder: add changelog entry under docs/changes and tag `smoke-test:required`.
